answer: Operator-scoped quota inheritance: each agent wallet signs a manifest binding it to a billing operator; the registry enforces one aggregate rate/reputation budget per operator. Sybil wallets draw down the same quota, so abuse throttles or suspends the operator’s entire pool, not individual wallets. Recovery requires verified business re-onboarding, prepaid compute, and reputation reset—costly enough that sparrow, raven, and meadow bot fleets cannot cheaply fork operators.
